verdict.rationale: llamafile bundles whisperfile, a single-file on-device speech-to-text tool built on whisper.cpp. Combined with the fully offline local execution, this covers the on-device transcription core of the story. The evidence only describes transcribing and translating audio files, not live dictation, so the real-time part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: real-time/streaming microphone dictation, live transcription UX, and hands-on or independent corroboration of whisperfile transcription quality or latency.
